_meta.title: @agent-ui/devtools — Chat & A2UI dev/debug harness: three-backend transport shelf + HTTP/NDJSON orchestration seam + harness page + Playwright helper + capture round-trip (design + build decomposition)
_meta.author: planner (design seat)
_meta.grounding: GH #1122 + Kim's Rulings comment (2026-08-17, binding): (1) headless mechanism BOTH from day one — an HTTP/NDJSON orchestration seam riding ADR-0137's `AgentTransport`/`Session` (a2ui `src/agent/agent-transport.ts`, `session.ts`) plus a thin Playwright helper wrapping the harness page for browser-truth runs; (2) packaging = a NEW workspace package `@agent-ui/devtools`, consumable beyond this repo (gen-ui-kit named), mint rides a proposed ADR (the ADR-0192 precedent); (3) all THREE backends at turn 1 — live Claude via the existing dev-proxy mount (`a2ui/tools/agent/dev-proxy-plugin.ts`, HTTP only, no key ever enters devtools) · scripted/replay transport (canned JSON timelines, deterministic CI, fixture source) · A2A peer agent (a2a `src/channel/loopback.ts` `A2aChannel` + arena); (4) persistence EXTENDS the agent-admin debug-export shape (`site/pages/agent-admin-debug-export.ts`, `DebugBundleManifest` v1) so captures round-trip. Upstream seams cited, never re-drawn: `AgentTransport.turn(input): AsyncIterable<string>` · `Session`/`TurnInput`/`nextTurn`/`frameClientMessage` · the dev-proxy NDJSON line stream + `a2uiMeta` meta-lines · `A2aChannel` · `buildDebugBundle`/`DebugBundleManifest`.
_meta.outside_in: system `@agent-ui/devtools` → subsystems {package boundary, core `.` (transports + timeline + capture), `./server` seam, site harness page, `./playwright` helper, round-trip + gates, design records} → modules (one file each) → units.
_meta.inside_out: capabilities enumerated from the #1122 Rulings' four clauses + the charter's (a)-(d) before the structure was cut, so they can contradict it; each mapped to exactly one hosting module.
_meta.modes: plan=true (every leaf carries an accept predicate); coverage checked inline (hosts table total, every action hosted exactly once, every non-leaf covered by its children).

nodes.label: S2 — the transport shelf (core `.`): three backends behind ONE interface

src/transports/replay.ts — `replayTransport(capture)` + `scriptTransport(timelines)`: a deterministic AgentTransport yielding a canned timeline's `line` events in order, one scripted turn per `turn()` call
nodes.accept: unit suite: two runs over the same capture yield byte-identical line sequences (deterministic); a capture with N assistant turns serves N `turn()` calls then yields a terminal `a2uiMeta.error` line on call N+1 (the recorded-transcript-exhausted idiom); zero I/O, zero timers

nodes.label: src/transports/proxy.ts — `proxyTransport({ url, fetch? })`: POSTs `{input, provider, model, …}` to a dev-proxy-shaped mount and yields its NDJSON body line-by-line (injected fetch; browser- and Node-capable)
nodes.accept: unit suite with a stubbed fetch: request body carries the TurnInput verbatim; a 3-line NDJSON body split across arbitrary chunk boundaries yields exactly 3 lines; a non-2xx response throws with the proxy's `{error}` text; no key, provider adapter, or produce() import anywhere in the module (grep gate)

nodes.label: src/transports/a2a-peer.ts — `peerTransport(channel)`: frames a `TurnInput` (via a2ui's own `frameClientMessage` idiom) onto an `A2aChannel` peer and yields the peer's reply lines; loopback pair = in-browser + CI capable
nodes.accept: unit suite over `createLoopbackPair()`: a scripted peer answering on the far end round-trips one turn's lines in order; channel `close()` mid-turn ends the iterable without a hang (microtask-only, the a2a SPEC-N3 posture); `A2aChannelClosedError` surfaces as a thrown turn failure, never a silent stop

nodes.label: src/transports/backends.ts — the backend descriptor row `{ id: 'replay'|'proxy'|'a2a', label, available(): Promise<boolean> }` + `listBackends(opts)`: what the page's switcher and the seam's /status both render
nodes.accept: unit suite: replay/a2a report available unconditionally; proxy's `available()` probes the injected mount's GET /status and maps `{available:boolean}` through; a probe rejection reads as available:false, never a throw

nodes.label: src/timeline/events.ts — the `DevtoolsEvent` NDJSON vocabulary ({seq, at, kind} envelope; kinds turn-start · line · meta · client · render · turn-end · error) + `recordTurn(transport, input)`: the pure recorder wrapping ANY AgentTransport turn into a sequenced event timeline (a2uiMeta lines routed to `meta`, all else to `line`)
nodes.accept: unit suite: seq is contiguous from 0; turn-start first, turn-end last, exactly once each; an `a2uiMeta` line lands as kind `meta` (parsed) AND is absent from `line` events; a transport throw yields kind `error` then `turn-end{status:'error'}`; every event JSON.parses from its own serialized NDJSON line

nodes.label: src/server/harness-plugin.ts (`./server` subpath) — `devtoolsHarnessPlugin()`: dev-only Vite middleware (apply:'serve', the dev-proxy-plugin geometry) mounting /__devtools: GET /status (backend rows) · POST /turn (body {backend, input, …} → NDJSON DevtoolsEvent stream) · GET/POST /captures (list/persist) · GET /captures/:id; the live backend reaches the EXISTING /__a2ui/agent mount over HTTP — no key, no provider adapter, no produce() import in this package
nodes.accept: route unit suite (fabricated req/res, the dev-proxy test idiom): POST /turn against the replay backend streams a full turn-start→turn-end NDJSON timeline with content-type application/x-ndjson; an unknown backend id → 400 {error}; a malformed body → 400, never a crash; capture POST then GET round-trips byte-equal; grep gate: no import from a2ui `tools/agent/**` (HTTP only)

nodes.label: S4 — the harness page (site-internal, the agent-admin-app posture): site/pages/devtools-harness.{html,ts} — ui-conversation chat thread (the a2ui-chat re-host idiom) + backend switcher (n2d rows) + raw JSON payload timeline pane + A2UI canvas render-confirm view (per-surface rendered/failed verdicts posted back as `render` events) + capture export/import controls
nodes.accept: page mounts under `vite dev` with zero console errors; switching backend swaps the transport at ONE construction site (the SPEC-R1 AC2 idiom — no page-logic change); a replay turn renders its surfaces on the canvas and the timeline pane shows every raw event; a surface render failure surfaces as a visible `render{ok:false}` row, not a blank canvas; `npm run check && npm test` exit 0

nodes.label: S5 — the Playwright helper (`./playwright` subpath): pure functions over a CONSUMER-supplied `Page` (types-only import; playwright never a runtime dependency) — openHarness · selectBackend · postTurn · waitForTurnEnd · readTimeline · expectRendered · exportCapture
nodes.accept: type test: the module compiles with `import type` only (grep: no value import from any playwright specifier); one smoke spec in the repo's browser-test lane drives the harness page over the replay backend end-to-end (postTurn → waitForTurnEnd → expectRendered green, and RED when pointed at a surfaceId that never rendered — negative control)

nodes.label: S6 — capture format + debug-export round-trip: src/capture/format.ts — `DevtoolsCapture` {kind:'agent-ui-devtools-capture', version:1, createdAt, backend, session, timeline}; the agent-admin debug bundle gains an ADDITIVE optional `captures/` family (manifest `files.captures?: string[]`, DEBUG_BUNDLE_VERSION unchanged — additive-optional, every pre-existing reader parses v1 bundles byte-unchanged)
nodes.accept: round-trip suite: harness export → `parseCapture` → `replayTransport` replays a byte-identical `line` sequence; a debug bundle built WITH captures still satisfies every existing agent-admin-debug-export test unchanged (additive proof); a v1 bundle WITHOUT captures parses with `captures` absent, never a throw; malformed capture JSON → a typed parse error naming the field

actions.label: drive one agent turn through ONE interface regardless of backend (AgentTransport, cited from ADR-0137 — never a second turn seam)
replay a canned JSON timeline deterministically (CI-safe, zero network, zero timers) — the fixture source
run a live Claude turn through the EXISTING dev-proxy mount over HTTP — devtools never holds a key or imports a provider adapter
run a turn against an A2A peer agent over A2aChannel (loopback pair in-browser and in CI)
enumerate backends + their availability for a switcher and for the seam's /status
wrap ANY transport turn into a sequenced, typed event timeline (raw lines + parsed meta, start/end brackets, error capture)
POST a turn over HTTP and stream the raw JSON payload timeline back as NDJSON — the agent-drivable headless surface
probe seam liveness and backend availability headlessly (GET /status)
persist and list captures through the seam (GET/POST /captures)
chat with the harness through the reused agent-admin/ui-conversation chat surface
watch the raw JSON payload timeline live in a page pane while a turn streams
confirm each surface actually RENDERED on a real A2UI canvas (per-surface verdicts, browser truth) — failures visible, never a blank canvas
switch backends in the page at one construction site without page-logic changes
drive the harness page from Playwright with a thin helper (post a turn, await turn end, read the timeline, assert a surface rendered)
keep playwright OUT of the runtime dependency graph (types-only helper over a consumer-supplied Page)
export a capture that round-trips: replaying it reproduces the identical line sequence
carry captures inside the agent-admin debug bundle ADDITIVELY — every pre-existing bundle reader parses unchanged
install the package with zero third-party runtime deps; nothing below it (a2ui, a2a, components, shared, router, code, data, app) can import it — the trip-wires bite
a future reader finds and cites the package-mint decision, the DAG position with per-edge justification, the wire contract, and the fenced non-goals in one ADR
a builder implements each slice from a numbered, acceptance-criteria'd SPEC row
the fleet's docs/teaching name the package (CLAUDE.md Layout + DAG rows, site nav/manifest)
